ideas.pitch: An autonomous agent system that monitors live Toronto TTC and GO Transit feeds to predict vehicle failures and delays using multi-agent diagnostics.
ideas.title: Toronto Winter Transit Multi-Agent IoT Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning pattern of autonomous multi-agent diagnostic platforms that process real-time operational feeds.

ideas.pitch: A predictive web dashboard forecasting water quality and harmful algal bloom risks for Lake Ontario using historical buoy data and machine learning.
ideas.title: Lake Ontario Algal Bloom Early Warning Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors a first-place environmental IoT and predictive analytics project tailored directly to local geography.

ideas.pitch: An automated waste classification system running locally on low-power hardware to sort recyclables from compost on university grounds.
ideas.title: Edge AI Smart Bin for University Campuses
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning formula of hardware-integrated AI classifiers demonstrated in successful robotics hackathon entries.

ideas.pitch: A real-time asset tracker using BLE beacons and a local TypeScript gateway to prevent loss of expensive lab equipment across university buildings.
ideas.title: Bluetooth Low Energy Inventory Mesh for Labs
ideas.why_it_could_win: Built on the grand-prize-winning concept of localized BLE hardware tracking systems that solve practical campus problems.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first coding assistant extension that performs static analysis and security checks using lightweight local models without sending source code to external servers.
ideas.title: Local AI Code Review Extension
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the offline developer tooling strategy that secured runner-up finishes in developer ecosystem hackathons.
